about: Licence policy for every power Kit to Clip offers and every package the engine installs. Kit to Clip is free and for any use, including commercial work, so a licence that limits commercial use, forces our code open (AGPL) or needs a payment is blocked. Unknown or custom terms are reviewed by a person and the decision is recorded on the card. A block can never be overridden.

usages.library: loaded or imported by Kit to Clip or the video page
usages.file-in-project: an unmodified file copied into one video project, credited in CREDITS.md
usages.separate-program: a program Kit to Clip only runs from the command line; nothing of it is copied into our code
usages.model-weights: trained weights a tool downloads and runs

block.why: would force our code open when used over a network
commercial use needs a paid licence until a later date
commercial use limited to a trial period
forbids selling services built on it
limits offering it as a service
commercial use capped by revenue or size
companies above 3 people need a paid licence

review.why: custom no-charge licence, not open source
terms need a person to read them

libtess.note: SGI Free Software License B 2.0, which since 2008 is the X11 (MIT-style) licence; bundled inside p5.min.js, and the p5 card ships its licence file

pytorch-wavelets.note: MIT for its DWT code, which is all ACE-Step uses (DWT1DForward/DWT1DInverse, haar, for its default 'DCW' on Turbo). Its DTCWT code is research-only (Kingsbury) and is never imported by Kit to Clip. Turn DCW off in ace_music.py to avoid the package entirely
pytorch-wavelets.by: Claude (read the licence at its source)

torchao.note: BSD-3-Clause style (github.com/pytorch/ao LICENSE); PyPI has no licence field
torchao.by: Claude (read the licence at its source)

torchcodec.note: BSD-3-Clause (github.com/pytorch/torchcodec); PyPI has no licence field
torchcodec.by: Claude (read the licence at its source)

kokoro-onnx.note: MIT (github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx); PyPI has no licence field
kokoro-onnx.by: Claude (read the licence at its source)

espeakng-loader.note: MIT (github.com/thewh1teagle/espeakng-loader); it bundles the espeak-ng library (GPL-3.0), which runs only inside the voice tool, a separate program Kit to Clip calls
espeakng-loader.by: Claude (read the licence at its source)

gsap.note: Webflow's Standard 'no charge' licence (gsap.com/standard-license): free for commercial use; its limit is building a no-code animation tool that competes with Webflow, which Kit to Clip is not
